newsitem.title: USA: Global Marine to buy two rigs for $250 million.
newsitem.headline: Global Marine to buy two rigs for $250 million.

text.p: Global Marine Inc. will buy two deep-water offshore drilling rigs from Danish shipping and energy group Maersk for $250 million, the companies said Monday.
Global Marine said it will pay $150 million for the Maersk Vinlander and $100 million for the Maersk Jutlander.
The company said the purchases will be funded with an expanded bank credit facility and cash on hand.
The Maersk Vinlander is operating in the British sector of the North Sea, and the Maersk Jutlander is operating in the Norwegian sector of the North Sea, the company said.
Global Marine said it will be paid $71 million by Maersk over three-and-a-half years to continue using the rig to complete previous drilling commitments offshore Norway.
Maersk is a subsidiary of the A.P. Moeller group.
Global Marine's stock rose 62.5 cents to $25.625 early on the New York Stock Exchange.
